fp.intro.text: Ready to plan tomorrow's flight, co-pilot? Remember: this is a learning game, not real flight training.
fp.intro.speaker: ziggy

fp.back.text: Welcome back, co-pilot. The planning table is ready.
fp.back.speaker: ziggy

fp.story.intro1.text: This is Ziggy, the calmest pilot at Sky School. Nothing ruffles him.

fp.story.intro2.text: Tomorrow he's flying Bobbo to the island festival.

fp.story.intro3.text: Good pilots plan first: the wing, the route, the weather and the checklist.

fp.story.intro4.text: Will you be my co-pilot? We'll make the final call together.
fp.story.intro4.speaker: ziggy

fp.story.between2.text: Nice work. The plan is coming together.
fp.story.between2.speaker: ziggy

fp.story.between4.text: Halfway there. Bobbo is already packing his festival hat.

fp.story.between6.text: Almost ready. Then it's time for the final call.
fp.story.between6.speaker: ziggy

fp.story.outro.go.text: Everything checked out. Ziggy and Bobbo took off for the festival!

fp.story.outro.wait.text: The weather said wait, so they waited an hour. Then the sky cleared, and off they flew.

fp.story.outro.fix.text: You spotted the problem. Once it was sorted, they flew safely to the festival.

fp.story.outro2.text: A careful plan is the best part of any flight. Thanks, co-pilot.
fp.story.outro2.speaker: ziggy

fp.prompt.tutorial.text: Slide the angle up and watch the lift meter. Where does the wing stall?
fp.prompt.tutorial.speaker: ziggy

fp.prompt.find.text: Tilt the wing a degree at a time. At what angle does it stall?
fp.prompt.find.speaker: ziggy

fp.prompt.flaps.text: Flaps are down. Find this wing's new stall angle.
fp.prompt.flaps.speaker: ziggy

fp.prompt.lift.speed.text: Keep the angle the same and speed up the air. What happens to lift?
fp.prompt.lift.speed.speaker: ziggy

fp.prompt.lift.angle.text: Keep the speed the same and tilt the wing a little more. What happens to lift?
fp.prompt.lift.angle.speaker: ziggy

fp.prompt.speed.fast.text: The air is fast, but the wing is tilted a lot. Does it stall?
fp.prompt.speed.fast.speaker: ziggy

fp.prompt.speed.slow.text: The air is slow, and the wing is only tilted a little. Does it stall?
fp.prompt.speed.slow.speaker: ziggy

fp.prompt.engine.text: This model has no engine, but it still stalled. So what is a stall?
fp.prompt.engine.speaker: ziggy

fp.prompt.recover.text: The wing has stalled. What brings the smooth airflow back?
fp.prompt.recover.speaker: ziggy

fp.prompt.leg.text: How many minutes will this leg take?
fp.prompt.leg.speaker: ziggy

fp.prompt.leg.wind.text: There's wind on this leg. How many minutes will it take?
fp.prompt.leg.wind.speaker: ziggy

fp.prompt.leg.round.text: How many minutes will this leg take, to the nearest minute?
fp.prompt.leg.round.speaker: ziggy

fp.prompt.leg.total.text: Two legs this time. How many minutes in total?
fp.prompt.leg.total.speaker: ziggy

fp.prompt.decode.text: Here's the weather report. Match each group to what it means.
fp.prompt.decode.speaker: ziggy

fp.prompt.call.text: Check the weather against my practice card. Fly or wait?
fp.prompt.call.speaker: ziggy

fp.prompt.order.text: Put the steps in order, from planning to take-off.
fp.prompt.order.speaker: ziggy

fp.prompt.order.skip.text: Put the steps in order. One card doesn't belong, so leave it out.
fp.prompt.order.skip.speaker: ziggy

fp.prompt.missed.text: My planning notes miss one item from the card. Which one?
fp.prompt.missed.speaker: ziggy

fp.prompt.imsafe.text: Morning check. Am I ready to fly? Use IMSAFE.
fp.prompt.imsafe.speaker: ziggy

fp.prompt.brief.text: Final briefing before take-off. What's the call, co-pilot?
fp.prompt.brief.speaker: ziggy

fp.help.find.text: Lift grows as the wing tilts, until one angle where the air can't follow the top. That's the stall.
fp.help.find.speaker: dabble

fp.help.flaps.text: Flaps give more lift at the same angle, but the wing stalls a little sooner. Let's test it!
fp.help.flaps.speaker: dabble

fp.help.lift.text: A wing makes lift by turning air downward. Change one thing at a time and watch the meter.
fp.help.lift.speaker: dabble

fp.help.speed.text: A stall is about the angle, not the speed. Compare the angle with this wing's stall angle.
fp.help.speed.speaker: dabble

fp.help.engine.text: Look: no engine in the tunnel at all. Watch the smoke when the wing tilts too far.
fp.help.engine.speaker: dabble

fp.help.recover.text: The smoke broke away because the angle is too big. What would make the angle smaller?
fp.help.recover.speaker: dabble

fp.help.leg.text: Time is distance divided by speed. Multiply by sixty to turn hours into minutes.
fp.help.leg.speaker: dabble

fp.help.wind.text: Find groundspeed first. A headwind takes knots away; a tailwind adds them.
fp.help.wind.speaker: dabble

fp.help.round.text: Work it out exactly, then round to the nearest whole minute.
fp.help.round.speaker: dabble

fp.help.total.text: Time each leg on its own, then add the two times together.
fp.help.total.speaker: dabble

fp.help.decode.text: A weather report is a code. Each group has one job: wind, visibility, clouds or temperature.
fp.help.decode.speaker: dabble

fp.help.call.text: Check one line of the card at a time. If any line is outside it, the plan is to wait.
fp.help.call.speaker: dabble

fp.help.order.text: Ask of each step: what do I need to know before I can do this one?
fp.help.order.speaker: dabble

fp.help.missed.text: Match each note to a line on the card. The line with no note is the missing one.
fp.help.missed.speaker: dabble

fp.help.imsafe.text: IMSAFE stands for illness, medication, stress, alcohol, fatigue and emotion. Check every letter.
fp.help.imsafe.speaker: dabble

fp.help.brief.text: Look at every row of the board: route, weather, pilot and plane. One problem is enough to change the plan.
fp.help.brief.speaker: dabble

fp.hint.low.text: Lift was still climbing there. Keep tilting until it suddenly drops.
fp.hint.low.speaker: dabble

fp.hint.high.text: That's past the stall: the smoke has already broken away. Come back to the highest lift.
fp.hint.high.speaker: dabble

fp.hint.lift.speed.text: Slide the speed up and watch the meter. Faster air means more air turned down each second.
fp.hint.lift.speed.speaker: dabble

fp.hint.lift.angle.text: Below the stall angle, tilting more turns more air downward. Try it and watch the meter.
fp.hint.lift.angle.speaker: dabble

fp.hint.engine.text: In flying, a stall isn't about the engine. Even a glider with no engine can stall.
fp.hint.engine.speaker: dabble

fp.hint.anyspeed.text: Speed doesn't stop a stall. Past the critical angle, the air breaks away at any speed.
fp.hint.anyspeed.speaker: dabble

fp.hint.slow.text: Slow means less lift, but not a stall. Look at the smoke: is it still smooth?
fp.hint.slow.speaker: dabble

fp.hint.angle.text: Compare the angle with this wing's stall angle. Is it past it?
fp.hint.angle.speaker: dabble

fp.hint.pullup.text: Pulling up makes the angle even bigger. Try it on the slider: what does the smoke do?
fp.hint.pullup.speaker: dabble

fp.hint.power.text: The angle is still too big, so the smoke stays broken. What makes the angle smaller?
fp.hint.power.speaker: dabble

fp.hint.add.text: Speed and distance aren't added. Time is distance divided by speed.
fp.hint.add.speaker: dabble

fp.hint.flip.text: That's speed divided by distance. Flip it: distance divided by speed.
fp.hint.flip.speaker: dabble

fp.hint.noWind.text: Don't forget the wind. Work out the groundspeed first.
fp.hint.noWind.speaker: dabble

fp.hint.windWay.text: Check the wind's direction. A headwind slows you down; a tailwind speeds you up.
fp.hint.windWay.speaker: dabble

fp.hint.hours.text: That's in hours. Multiply by sixty to get minutes.
fp.hint.hours.speaker: dabble

fp.hint.round.text: So close! Check the rounding: is the decimal part more or less than a half?
fp.hint.round.speaker: dabble

fp.hint.tsdHigh.text: That's a bit too long. Try distance times sixty, divided by the speed.
fp.hint.tsdHigh.speaker: dabble

fp.hint.tsdLow.text: That's a bit too short. Try distance times sixty, divided by the speed.
fp.hint.tsdLow.speaker: dabble

fp.hint.windTo.text: A wind group says where the wind comes from, not where it's going.
fp.hint.windTo.speaker: dabble

fp.hint.km.text: SM means statute miles, the kind of miles on a road sign.
fp.hint.km.speaker: dabble

fp.hint.hundreds.text: Cloud heights are in hundreds of feet. Add two zeros.
fp.hint.hundreds.speaker: dabble

fp.hint.zulu.text: The Z means Zulu time, which is UTC, not local time.
fp.hint.zulu.speaker: dabble

fp.hint.tempDew.text: The two numbers are the temperature and the dew point, not a high and a low.
fp.hint.tempDew.speaker: dabble

fp.hint.group.time.text: The group ending in Z is the day and time of the report.
fp.hint.group.time.speaker: dabble

fp.hint.group.wind.text: The group ending in KT is the wind: direction first, then knots.
fp.hint.group.wind.speaker: dabble

fp.hint.group.vis.text: The group ending in SM is the visibility.
fp.hint.group.vis.speaker: dabble

fp.hint.group.cloud.text: Cloud groups start with how much sky is covered: few, scattered, broken or overcast.
fp.hint.group.cloud.speaker: dabble

fp.hint.group.temp.text: The group with a slash is temperature, then dew point.
fp.hint.group.temp.speaker: dabble

fp.hint.decode.text: Look at the letters at the end of each group. They tell you its job.
fp.hint.decode.speaker: dabble

fp.hint.ceiling.text: A ceiling is the lowest broken or overcast layer. Few and scattered clouds don't count.
fp.hint.ceiling.speaker: dabble

fp.hint.windCard.text: Read the wind group's speed again and compare it with the card.
fp.hint.windCard.speaker: dabble

fp.hint.card.text: Check each line of the card against the report, one at a time.
fp.hint.card.speaker: dabble

fp.hint.skip.text: One card skips a safety step. Safe pilots never skip those, even when they're late.
fp.hint.skip.speaker: dabble

fp.hint.order.text: Some steps were in the right place. For the others, ask: what has to come first?
fp.hint.order.speaker: dabble

fp.hint.local.text: Even a short hop needs the weather. Weather can change quickly.
fp.hint.local.speaker: dabble

fp.hint.missed.text: Tick off each line of the card that a note covers. Which line is left?
fp.hint.missed.speaker: dabble

fp.hint.push.text: Experience doesn't fix being unwell or tired. Every pilot checks IMSAFE.
fp.hint.push.speaker: dabble

fp.hint.notready.text: Read the morning note again. Does one IMSAFE letter apply?
fp.hint.notready.speaker: dabble

fp.hint.imsafe.text: Close! Which letter of IMSAFE does the note really describe?
fp.hint.imsafe.speaker: dabble

fp.hint.pressure.text: Wanting to get there isn't a reason to go. Check what the board says.
fp.hint.pressure.speaker: dabble

fp.hint.brief.go.text: One row of the board has a problem. Check each row again.
fp.hint.brief.go.speaker: dabble

fp.hint.brief.text: Check each row of the board. Which one really has the problem?
fp.hint.brief.speaker: dabble

fp.retry.text: Not quite. Let's take another look.
fp.retry.speaker: ziggy

fp.model.text: Here's how a pilot works it out. Follow the steps, then you try.
fp.model.speaker: ziggy

fp.idle.text: Take your time. Try something on the board.
fp.idle.speaker: ziggy

fp.praise.find.text: You tested it angle by angle and found the stall.
fp.praise.find.speaker: ziggy

fp.praise.lift.text: You changed one thing at a time and watched the meter.
fp.praise.lift.speaker: ziggy

fp.praise.speed.text: You compared the angle, not the speed. Spot on.
fp.praise.speed.speaker: ziggy

fp.praise.engine.text: Right: a stall is about the wing's angle, not the engine.
fp.praise.engine.speaker: ziggy

fp.praise.recover.text: Lower the nose first. That's how pilots recover.
fp.praise.recover.speaker: ziggy

fp.praise.leg.text: Distance divided by speed. Nicely worked.
fp.praise.leg.speaker: ziggy

fp.praise.leg2.text: Leg timed. You kept the units straight.
fp.praise.leg2.speaker: ziggy

fp.praise.wind.text: You worked out the groundspeed first. That's the pilot's way.
fp.praise.wind.speaker: ziggy

fp.praise.call.text: You checked each line against the card.
fp.praise.call.speaker: ziggy

fp.praise.order.text: Each step has what it needs before it. Great checklist.
fp.praise.order.speaker: ziggy

fp.praise.missed.text: You matched every note to the card and found the gap.
fp.praise.missed.speaker: ziggy

fp.praise.imsafe.text: You checked every letter before deciding.
fp.praise.imsafe.speaker: ziggy

fp.praise.brief.text: A calm, careful call. That's real pilot thinking.
fp.praise.brief.speaker: ziggy
